title: See the agents in action
lead: Five scenarios show the platform through real examples: a customer chat with external tool calls, inbound and outbound voice calls, lead hunting, and a chat widget on your own site.
disclaimer: This is a pre-recorded scenario, not a live agent. A real run needs your own AI provider API keys, so it cannot happen on a landing page — that way we burn neither your tokens nor anyone else's.

videos.title: How the agent actually works
videos.lead: The tabs above are an interactive scenario simulation. Below are real recordings of the agent in a live conversation: voice cloning and an outbound call.
videos.whyTitle: Why a video and not a live agent?
videos.whyBody: A live call cannot happen on a landing page: a real run needs your own AI provider API keys, and every opened call would burn tokens — ours or yours. So this is a saved recording of a real run: you can replay it as many times as you want, and it sends no request to the model at all.
videos.note: Videos never start on their own — press ▶ to watch.

modelRealtime.title: Cloned voice
modelRealtime.caption: A real-time voice model: replies are spoken with a cloned voice. The recording contains the model's real cloned voice.
modelRealtime.aria: Video: real-time voice model with voice cloning, with real sound

voiceCall.title: Outbound call
voiceCall.caption: The agent dials the contact itself and runs the conversation. The recording has no real agent voice — the caller is the only one who hears it. Replies from the agent and the caller's speech appear as live transcriptions.
voiceCall.aria: Video: agent's outbound voice call, with transcription of the agent's and caller's voices

text.name: Text agent
text.desc: One Telegram conversation: the agent streams its reply, calls the tools it needs on its own — draws an image, sends the price list, books a grooming slot — and hands the chat to a human once it hits the edge of its authority.

voice.name: Inbound call
voice.desc: An incoming Telegram call answered by voice in real time. The same mode works in WhatsApp — no GraphAPI, a direct connection instead.

outbound.name: Outbound call
outbound.desc: You enter a number or username and pick the channel — Telegram or WhatsApp. During the call you see both the caller's speech and the model's replies transcribed; interrupt the agent and it stops mid-sentence.

lead.name: Lead hunting
lead.desc: You upload a contact list, bring up several Telegram and WhatsApp bots behind your own proxies, set a schedule and a goal. From there the bots run the conversations themselves and hand over a hot lead once the goal is reached.

widget.name: Website widget
widget.desc: The chat widget embeds into your site with a single line of code. Same agent, same conversation history — except the customer stays on your page instead of leaving for a messenger.

text.e2: Contact created in CRM, conversation linked
text.e4: Conversation history and goal pushed to CRM
text.m1: Hi! I'm looking for food for a kitten, he's 3 months old. What would you recommend?
text.m2:
Hello! My name is Vasilich, I'm the resident cat expert 🐱

For a three-month-old kitten pick food labelled **kitten** — it has more protein and calcium.

| Food | Weight | Price |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Murchella Kitten | 1.5 kg | $11 |
| Lapki Junior | 2 kg | $14 |

Both are in stock.
text.m3: What does that Murchella look like? Show me a picture.
text.m4: Here's our signature cat from the packaging. The pack is bright, you won't miss it 🙂
text.m5: Great. Send me the full price list and book us a grooming slot on Saturday.
text.m6:
Price list sent — it covers the whole range with prices.

Grooming is confirmed: **Saturday, 12:00**, groomer Lena. I'll remind you an hour before.
text.m7: One more thing: I'd like to return an opened bag of food, the kitten won't eat it.
text.m8: Hello, this is Olga. I can see the whole conversation — no need to repeat anything. We'll take the opened pack as an exception if it's been less than 14 days. I'll process the refund today.

voice.e3: Checking free slots in the schedule
voice.m1: Murchalnya cat café, hello! My name is Anna, how can I help?
voice.m2: Hi! I'd like to book a table for the weekend, there will be four of us.
voice.m3: Of course. Saturday is free at 14:00 and 17:30, Sunday from 12:00. Which works better?
voice.m4: Let's do Saturday, half past five.
voice.m5: You're booked for Saturday, 17:30, a table for four by the window with the cats. I'll send a Telegram reminder an hour before. Have a great day!

outbound.e3: Caller interrupted — reply cut off, agent is listening
outbound.m1: Hello! This is Murchalnya vet clinic. Just a reminder that Barsik is due for his booster shot.
outbound.m2: Oh, right. Completely slipped my mind.
outbound.m3: No problem at all. We have free slots on Thursday morning and Friday after…
outbound.m4: Friday works, in the evening if possible.
outbound.m5: Friday evening we have 18:00 and 19:30. Which suits you better?
outbound.m7: Barsik is booked for Friday, 18:00, with Dr. Smirnova. Please bring his vaccination record. Have a good one!

lead.m1: Good afternoon! We help automate handling of requests coming from messengers. Is that relevant for you?
lead.m2: Possibly. How much does it cost and how long does the rollout take?
lead.m3: Pricing depends on volume. How many requests a day do you handle now, and how many people are on it?
lead.m4: Around 200 a day, three managers on it. Let's talk — send me a contact.
lead.m5: Great, I'm passing you to a colleague — he'll reach out within the hour with a quote for your volume.

widget.m1: Hi! Do you have scratching posts for large cats? My Maine Coon is destroying the sofa.
widget.m2:
Hello! My condolences to the sofa 🙂

For Maine Coons go for models from **90 cm** — otherwise the cat can't stretch to full height and keeps working on your furniture.

- Jungle Tower, 120 cm — $54
- Sisal Maxi post, 95 cm — $35

Both hold up to 15 kg.
widget.m3: I'll take the Jungle Tower. Here's my email, send me an invoice: irina@example.com
widget.m4:
Invoice sent to your email, it's valid for three days.

City delivery is **free**, we'll bring it the day after tomorrow. No assembly needed, it arrives ready to use.
